description:
Keep the card details you count on close, right from your Mac.

Holder gives credit cards, debit cards, IDs, memberships, loyalty cards, insurance cards, and more one private home. Stop digging through notes, photos, and messages when you need a number for checkout, travel, or a form.

Ready from the menu bar

Open the full vault when you need it, or use the menu bar when enabled to find a saved card without losing your place.

Find the right card fast

Clear card art and organized groups make it easy to spot the card you need. Open, copy, and use its details without going back to notes, photos, and messages.

Private where it counts

Holder works offline. Card details are protected in Apple Keychain and can sync with iCloud Keychain when available. Optional card images use iCloud Documents.

Protection when it matters

Use Touch ID or your device passcode to lock Holder. Sensitive actions like showing a security code, sharing, or deleting a card can ask for a fresh check.

The details you need, ready when you need them.
promotionalText: Keep the card details you need close on your Mac. Open Holder or the menu bar when enabled, find the right one, and get on with your day.
whatsNew:
Find the right card faster on Mac.

• Clearer card rows help you spot it at a glance.
• A refreshed look across Holder, from the icon to the card details screen.
• More reliable loading, saving, and access from the menu bar or main window.
• Sensitive actions can ask for a fresh check when protection is enabled.
